name: FOMOchat
tagline: AI group chat widget with an AI rep that answers visitor questions
description: FOMOchat adds an AI-powered group chat to a website, landing page, or webinar. Each chat includes an AI company rep trained on the site's content that answers visitor questions in real time, while other participants in the conversation add social proof. Chat can sync to a video or webinar timeline so the rep responds at the right moments in a pitch. Teams can customize colors, positioning, and conversation style, and set facts and guardrails so the rep adds qualifiers when unsure. It installs without coding and has a free plan.
